select tq.*, ep.experiment_name as experiment_plan_name, ep.experiment_title as experiment_plan_title, CASE WHEN ep.experiment_status = 'beEnd' THEN 'beEnd' WHEN ep.experiment_status = 'end' THEN 'end' ELSE NULL END as experiment_status from t_questionnaire tq left join t_experiment_plan ep on tq.experiment_plan_id = ep.id and ep.is_deleted = 0 where tq.is_deleted =0
and tq.questionnaire_name like concat('%', #{dto.questionnaireName} ,'%')
and (tq.questionnaire_attribution = #{userName} OR tq.status = 'OPEN')
and (tq.status = #{dto.status} and tq.questionnaire_attribution = #{userName})
and ((tq.status = #{dto.status} and tq.questionnaire_attribution = #{userName}) or (#{roleId} = 1 and tq.status = #{dto.status}))
and (tq.status = #{dto.status})
and tq.questionnaire_attribution = #{userName}
ORDER BY tq.update_date DESC

select tq.* from t_questionnaire tq where tq.is_deleted = 0
and tq.questionnaire_name like concat('%', #{dto.questionnaireName} ,'%')
and (tq.status = 'WAIT_REVIEW' OR tq.status = 'OPEN')
and tq.status = #{dto.status}
and (tq.status = #{dto.status})
ORDER BY tq.update_date DESC

SELECT jt.choiceSort AS optionSort, jt.choiceContext AS optionName FROM t_questionnaire_data tqa, JSON_TABLE ( qa_data, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( answerSort LONG PATH '$.answerSort', choiceSort LONG PATH '$.choices[*].choiceSort', choiceContext VARCHAR ( 255 ) PATH '$.choices[*].choiceContext' )) AS jt WHERE tqa.is_deleted = 0 and tqa.groups_id = #{groupsId} AND tqa.questionnaire_id = #{questionnaireId} AND jt.answerSort = #{questionSort} AND jt.choiceContext IS NOT NULL ORDER BY jt.answerSort
select count(id) from t_questionnaire where is_deleted = 0 and status = 'OPEN'
SELECT * FROM t_questionnaire ORDER BY update_date DESC
